title: A quiet morning between the mountains, before the rest of the world woke up

photos.description: A little distance from everything. Mountains, still water, and room to breathe.
A wider view of the mountains, with a lake in the distance and a green hillside in the foreground.
photos.alt: Grassy hillside above a lake and distant mountain ranges

photos.description: Following the edge of the coast, with nothing much planned beyond the next view.
The kind of place that makes you slow down. A quiet moment under the trees.
photos.alt: Tall forest trees disappearing into the fog
